g.text: Join Priya at the paper table.
Carry it to the chalk line.
Carry it to the chalk line.
Throw it from the stage steps.
Follow it to the fire door.
Go back and fold a different plane.
Wait to see what it does.
Watch it drop towards the cap.
Watch it rise towards the tiles.
Carry it to the chalk line.
Carry it to the chalk line.
Carry it to the chalk line.
Push it gently down the hall.
Let it go over a radiator.
Go back and fold a different plane.
Drop it with no push at all.
Launch it out over the stage.
Lean over and watch it go.
Lean over and watch it go.
Watch the folds of the curtain.
Curl the back of the wings.
Carry it to the chalk line.
Carry it to the chalk line.
Try to catch it out of the air.
Stand still and let it land.
Go back and fold a different plane.
Watch it drift towards the beams.
Watch it drift towards the open pane.
